answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a thread bet on surviving 87 epochs of grading, and every lantern settlement recomputes the pigment schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 87 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
